VBO:0007991.summary: Independent and enduring, the Kazakhski Tobet developed as a livestock guardian able to work across open country with little direction. Traditional duties included keeping predators away from herds, watching nomadic camps and accompanying caravans. Travelling with migrating livestock called for sustained effort over long distances, rather than constant instruction from a handler.
VBO:0007991.shortDescription: An independent livestock guardian, the Tobet traditionally watched herds and travelled far with nomadic pastoralists.

sources.title: Kazakh Tobet — Kazakhstan national breed standard, ministry order 101 as amended in 2024
sources.evidence: Exact Tobet row34 describes strength and endurance (Сильной и выносливой); excessive excitability/ uncontrolled aggression are undesirable. Rows35–48 establish adult anatomy, natural triangular hanging ears before cropping clause, undocked thick high-set sickle-down tail to hocks, coarse straight coat/shorter undercoat, and 10% longer-than-tall proportions. Only endurance enters profile; no Tazy independence/stranger traits transferred.

sources.title: Kazakh Tobet dogs in the genomic landscape — Perfilyeva et al., BMC Biology, 2025
sources.evidence: Background paragraph beginning The Kazakh Tobet is a large describes guarding livestock from predators and robbers, protecting nomadic settlements, escorting caravans, independent guarding across broad landscapes with minimal human supervision and long distances alongside migrating herds. Methods Sampling collection explicitly expert Kansonar evaluation of measurements/proportions/temperament against national standard, with region differences and lower-scoring animals included. Genetics/ancient continuity/survival and health claims not adopted.
